test_parallel_tool_calls: test the parallel tool-calling capability of a llama-server chat completions endpoint against six predefined test scenarios
test_parallel_multi_file_read: test that a model emits four parallel read_file tool calls for distinct config file paths in a single turn
test_parallel_trip_planning: test that a model calls three different tools (search_flights, search_hotels, search_restaurants) in parallel in one turn
test_parallel_language_toolkit: test that a model calls translate_text, get_definition, and get_synonyms in parallel for a single word
test_parallel_portfolio_check: test that a model emits five parallel get_stock_quote calls for different tickers in one turn
